name: Traditional Bakery Madeleines (French Sponge Cakes)
whyItWorks: Delicate shell-shaped French sponge cakes made of whipped eggs, butter, flour, and sugar. They have an ultra-tender crumb that dissolves effortlessly when dipped in warm tea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dunk into chamomile or peppermint tea for an afternoon treat.
watchOuts: Contains butter and eggs; enjoy 1–2 madeleines per serving.
